analysis.title: Reading Between The Lines: Semiconductor Upside Back In Play
key_insights: SOX bounced off 9,047 DeMark support with supportive daily and weekly Wave Counts (Wave 2 and 4). 70% of SOX constituents are at or near a DeMark Buy signal, and the daily TD Combo is an 11 Count, close to a Buy signal that would trigger on renewed weakness.

Fresh SOX gains beyond 10,498 would open 10,878, 11,711 and 12,756. Perl says SOX strength supports the S&P 500, which he sees on track for his 8,485 target next year, and the Nasdaq, given semiconductor weightings in each.

Perl advises not chasing the rebound in US yields. The weekly TD Combo signal for lower yield is still pending, and new highs would likely trigger a TD Combo 13, the first for lower yield since Sept. 22, 2023 at 5.1097%.

US 10y yield pulled back after a daily TD Sequential 9-13-9 from 5.3046% (Oct. 5) and is in DeMark Wave 4 on the daily chart. Tuesday's rally is seen as corrective, and a monthly TD Sequential 9-13-9 for lower yield is likely at month end (Nov. 30).

Recent gains in VIX and MOVE are seen as corrective within a longer-term downtrend. Volatility is unlikely to spike or stay elevated until the first monthly closes below 12.44 (VIX) and 59.20 (MOVE). Falling equity and bond volatility is expected to help an extended risk rally.
Near-term VIX support is 16.57 and MOVE downside trigger is 85.98.

EURUSD: daily chart is completing DeMark Wave 5 or C, weekly is completing Wave C, and the TD Combo is a 10 Count near a Buy signal. Perl says a low is close in time and price and one should not sell into weakness.

Gold: daily chart is completing Wave 5 or C and weekly Wave C at 3,870.74 TD Propulsion support. Gains beyond 4,148.50 would reinforce the recovery. Perl calls pullbacks corrective buying opportunities.
Gold miners (XAU Index) are basing, poised for daily Wave 3 up, with the TD Combo Buy signal from 295.80 (17-Jul) intact and the monthly count in Wave 3.
Euro Stoxx 50 weekly TD Buy Setup from 6,131 remains intact, supporting a broader European recovery. European Technology has completed Wave C and is in early Wave 1, and Retail is in Wave 3.
WTI is bearish: the weekly TD Sequential Sell from 103.27 (Oct. 23) for CL1 remains intact as the count moves from Wave 5 into Wave A. Perl treats WTI rallies as part of a broader topping prospect.
KOSPI: bullish recovery. The daily chart is poised for Wave 1 up, weekly is completing Wave 4, monthly is in Wave 3, and the TD Sequential Buy from 5,554 (Oct. 15) is intact.
Nikkei 225 is cautious. It has met the minimum requirement to complete Wave C but needs to reclaim 62,315 to ease the immediate downside threat.
India's NIFTY is constructive. It completed a weekly Wave C at 22,421 (Oct. 4) and is now in Wave 1, with a target above 26,430 next year.
US Consumer Discretionary, REITs, Real Estate, Homebuilders and Airlines are expected to extend recoveries per the DeMark indicators.
